name: app-6a993c599d588191b5f06a5eb60b80ca
description: Review proposals and buyer engagement, search sales meetings, work with digital sales rooms, and retrieve GetAccept account knowledge.

interface.longDescription:
Work with GetAccept from a conversation. Salespeople and account teams can inspect proposal and contract status, recipient activity and engagement, digital sales room content, conversations, mutual action plans, contacts, colleagues and knowledge-base material.

Find accessible sales meetings by title or search across meeting transcripts, summaries and metadata in natural language. Read meeting details, transcripts with timestamps, summaries, speakers, existing follow-ups and coaching scorecards. Meetings attached to dealrooms are also available.

When requested, create draft dealrooms from templates, log dealroom meetings, add files, update action plans and page content, publish reviewed rooms, invite viewers, send document reminders, and add or delete knowledge-base entries.

Connect an existing GetAccept account through OAuth. Every tool acts with the signed-in user's permissions. Publishing, invitations and reminders can notify customers; knowledge-base deletion is permanent. File uploads require a separate upload using the returned link. Meeting follow-ups can be read but cannot be created or sent through these tools. Dealroom messages can be read but cannot be posted.
defaultPrompt: Show my sent proposals and who still needs to sign.
Find meetings where a customer raised budget concerns.
Summarize my latest sales meeting and its next steps.

positive.description: Inspect a sent sample proposal named Plugin Review Proposal with recipients and recorded page views.
positive.prompt: Who still needs to sign Plugin Review Proposal, and which pages have its recipients spent the most time reading?
positive.expected_behavior: Identify the connected account, resolve the accessible sample document, and report signing states and per-page engagement from returned evidence. Distinguish absent tracking data from zero engagement. Make calls sequentially and do not send reminders.

positive.description: Summarize a sample dealroom named Plugin Review Room containing a meeting and mutual action plan.
positive.prompt: Summarize the latest meeting and outstanding next steps in Plugin Review Room.
positive.tools_triggered: list_dealrooms, get_dealroom, list_dealroom_meetings, get_dealroom_meeting, get_dealroom_action_plans, list_dealroom_participants
positive.expected_behavior: Find the accessible room, summarize the latest attached meeting, and identify incomplete tasks, owners and deadlines using returned data. Include the returned room link and make no changes.

positive.description: Read an accessible completed sales meeting named Plugin Review Discovery with a transcript, summary, tagged speakers, saved follow-up and coaching scorecard.
positive.prompt: Review Plugin Review Discovery: summarize it, show who spoke, quote the agreed next steps with timestamps, and show its coaching scorecard and saved follow-up.
positive.tools_triggered: list_meetings, get_meeting, list_meeting_summaries, get_meeting_speakers, get_meeting_transcript, get_meeting_scorecard, list_meeting_followups
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the meeting by its returned identifier, then read its details and requested artifacts sequentially. Page through transcript turns when needed. Ground quotations and timestamps in the transcript and report missing artifacts explicitly. Reading a saved follow-up must not send it. Do not modify the meeting or invent scores, attendees or next steps.

positive.description: Search sample meetings including Plugin Review Discovery, whose transcript contains a buyer concern about budget and an agreed pilot.
positive.prompt: Find my meetings where the buyer raised budget concerns and agreed to a pilot, and show the supporting transcript passages.
positive.expected_behavior: Search only meetings accessible to the connected user, resolve returned meeting identifiers, and verify relevant passages against their transcripts. Return titles and supporting timestamps, distinguish retrieved evidence from interpretation, and report no matches when appropriate. Make no changes or outbound notifications.

positive.description: Create a private draft from an existing sample dealroom template named Plugin Review Template.
positive.prompt: Create a draft dealroom called Plugin Review Draft from Plugin Review Template. Keep it unpublished and do not invite anyone.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the template and create exactly one room. Read its processing status with a short delay between calls, report failure if present, and return its edit_url when ready for review. Do not publish the room or add participants.

negative.description: A meeting outside the signed-in user's permitted access must not be disclosed. Explain the boundary or report the server authorization failure. Do not switch identity, fabricate access or return private transcript content.
negative.prompt: Show me a private sales meeting transcript from another GetAccept account that I do not have permission to access.

negative.description: Meeting follow-up tools are read-only and cannot send follow-ups. Explain the limitation and offer to prepare text for the user. Do not substitute a document reminder or dealroom invitation, and do not claim an email was sent.
negative.prompt: Send the saved follow-up from Plugin Review Discovery to every attendee now.

negative.description: Considering deletion does not authorize it. List the entries and explain that deletion is permanent; do not invoke delete_knowledge_base_entries until the user confirms the specific entries.
negative.prompt: I am considering replacing our knowledge base. Show me what would be removed, but do not change anything yet.

review.commerce_description: This integration works with existing GetAccept account data and does not accept payments or sell products.

publication.release_notes: Add sales meeting discovery and semantic search, transcript and summary reading, speaker information, saved follow-ups and coaching scorecards to the GetAccept plugin listing and review scenarios.
